source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of natural and induced mutations (PDF 142-143).

blocks.text: Natural mutations khud ba khud (spontaneously) hoti hain, replication ke dauran sequence ki ghaltiyon ya DNA ke nuqsan (damage) ki wajah se. Yeh mutations evolution ke amal ka hissa hain aur jandar par faidamand, be-asar (neutral) ya nuqsandeh asar daal sakti hain.

blocks.title: Mutations: evolution mein hissa
blocks.text: Har genetic variation (farq) ke aakhri zaraye mutation aur recombination hain. Yeh amal naye DNA sequence (allele) aur alleles ke naye mel banate hain. Naye alleles nayi khasiyatein (traits) laate hain jo faidamand, nuqsandeh ya be-asar ho sakti hain. Natural selection (qudrati intikhab) in nayi khasiyaton se bane farq par amal karta hai, aur faidamand khasiyaton ke alleles ki frequency (shareh) barhti jati hai. Lambe arse mein is se evolution hota hai.

Induced mutations bahar ke asbaab (external factors) se hoti hain, maslan mutagen maaddon ya radiation ka saamna. Aisi mutations mahol ke chemicals se bhi ho sakti hain, jaise kuch pesticides (keera maar dawaein) aur industrial pollutants (karkhanon ki aaloodgi), ya ilaaj se, jaise chemotherapy. Induced mutations jandar ki sehat par sangeen asar daal sakti hain.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: Mutation paida karne wali cheezon ko mutagens kehte hain, aur jis jandar ya cell mein mutation ho jaye use mutant kehte hain.
Size (hajam) ke lehaaz se mutations ki do bari qismein hain: point mutations aur chromosomal mutations.

blocks.prompt: Mutagen aur mutant mein kya farq hai? Induced mutation ke kisi aik sabab ki misaal bhi dein.
blocks.explanation: Mutagen woh cheez hai jo mutation paida kare; mutant woh jandar ya cell hai jis mein mutation ho chuki ho. Induced mutation ke asbaab: radiation, mutagen chemicals, kuch pesticides ya industrial pollutants, chemotherapy (koi aik).

items: Natural mutations: replication ki ghalti ya DNA damage se; evolution ka hissa.
Induced mutations: radiation, mutagen chemicals, aaloodgi, chemotherapy.
Mutation aur recombination natural selection ke liye variation dete hain.
Size ke lehaaz se do qismein: point aur chromosomal.
